# CG Business Consulting

> ISO certification and sustainability consulting firm specializing in rapid certification delivery (12 weeks), integrated management systems, and ESG/CSRD compliance across Europe.

CG Business Consulting (CGBC) provides comprehensive ISO consultancy services across quality, environmental, health & safety, energy, information security, and sustainability domains. The firm emphasizes integrated management system approaches and helps organizations achieve regulatory compliance including CSRD, ESRS, GDPR, and CCPA standards.

## Key Topics

- ISO 9001 Quality Management
- ISO 14001 Environmental Management
- ISO 45001 Occupational Health & Safety
- ISO 50001 Energy Management
- ISO 27001 Information Security
- ISO 27701 Privacy Management
- ISO 14064-1 Carbon Footprint
- ISO 22301 Business Continuity
- CSRD Compliance
- ESG Reporting
- QEHS Integrated Systems
- Double Materiality Assessment
- Sustainability Consulting
- ISO Audit Services
- Net-Zero Strategy

## Core ISO Certification Services

- [ISO Consultancy Services | CG Business Consulting](https://www.cgbusinessconsulting.com/iso-consultancy): CGBC's main ISO consultancy services covering ISO 9001, 14001, 50001, 45001, 27001
- [ISO 9001 Consulting Services | CG Business Consulting](https://www.cgbusinessconsulting.com/iso-consultancy/9001): ISO 9001 Quality Management System consulting and certification services
- [ISO 14001 2015 Consultants - CG Business Consulting](https://www.cgbusinessconsulting.com/iso-consultancy/14001): ISO 14001 Environmental Management System consulting within 12 weeks
- [ISO 45001 Consultants - ISO Certification Within 12 Weeks.](https://www.cgbusinessconsulting.com/iso-consultancy/45001): ISO 45001 Occupational Health & Safety Management System certification
- [ISO 50001 Consultants - Energy Management Certification](https://www.cgbusinessconsulting.com/iso-consultancy/50001): ISO 50001 Energy Management System certification and carbon reduction
- [ISO Audit Consultants - ISO Certification Consultants Ireland](https://www.cgbusinessconsulting.com/iso-consultancy/audit): ISO internal audit consulting across 9001, 14001, 45001, and 27001
